title: AI Text Cleaner | NoAITell
description: Remove AI tells, make text sound natural. Review writing patterns and clean formatting locally, with your meaning under your control.
body:
How it works

  1. Paste a small sample. Start with up to 500 words. Your draft stays in your browser.
  2. Review the tells. Inspect highlighted findings and choose Cleanup options. Keep Markdown when publishing to a Markdown editor.
  3. Clean and compare. Apply selected formatting fixes, review the diff, then copy your result. Scanning and reviewing are free; only requesting a result counts as a cleaning.

Common AI tells

Spot patterns that can make text feel formulaic, then choose what to edit.

Em dashes

Repeated interruptions can make prose feel formulaic; review punctuation in context.

Scaffold openers

Cut stock introductions when they delay the point you want to make.

Invisible characters

Inspect and clean unwanted copy artifacts that can interrupt text.

Examples: zero-width spaces and joiners

These are editing cues, not proof of AI authorship.

Capabilities and limits

Remove AI tells and make text sound natural, with your meaning under your control.

What it does

  • Clean invisible copy artifacts
  • Remove Markdown residue
  • Tidy whitespace and known tracking parameters
  • Flag formulaic phrases for review

What it can't do

  • Verify or remove statistical watermarks
  • Heavily rewrite or paraphrase your draft
  • Identify authorship from punctuation alone

Free plan

  • 3 cleanings per day on this device
  • Up to 500 words per cleaning
  • No sign-up required
  • Processed in your browser; never uploaded

A clean result means no issues were found by the selected rules; it is not evidence of human authorship.

Questions? Email noaitell@knowhy.net.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Text is processed in your browser and is not uploaded. The free quota stores only a date and use count in localStorage.

faqs.question: What can I clean for free?
faqs.answer: You get 3 cleanings per day on this device, up to 500 words each, with no sign-up. Scanning and reviewing do not use the allowance.

faqs.question: Does the cleaner rewrite my draft or remove statistical watermarks?
faqs.answer: No. It cleans selected formatting and character artifacts and flags writing patterns for your review. It does not paraphrase, verify authorship, or remove statistical vendor watermarks.

faqs.question: How do vendor watermarks and Unicode artifacts differ?
faqs.answer: Among the vendor systems covered here, Microsoft Windows AI text APIs are the character-based exception: Microsoft documents the sequence U+200B U+034F U+2060 U+200B. OpenAI textGrain, Claude watermarking, SynthID Text and Grok API watermarking use statistical signals. Statistical watermarks encode signals through word choice, not hidden characters. Heavy rewriting can disrupt those signals, but character cleaning cannot; this app does not perform heavy rewriting.
